Subject: Assurance needs for SIG/ISO review — initial artifact request

Hi Jonas,

As part of our vendor review for the upcoming SIG/ISO assessment we need to collect a compact assurance dossier showing control mappings and representative telemetry samples. The questions below are the things our InfoSec team will review first:

- Control mapping: SOC 2 control IDs matched to your implementation (owner, evidence location, document name).
- Telemetry snapshot: a short sample (anonymized) of request/response telemetry for inference flows (token counts, latency percentiles, cache hit-rates).
- Configuration excerpt: example config showing KV cache settings and retention window for a private deployment.
- Audit report: most recent attestation summary (redaction OK).

Can you confirm what artifacts you can provide by next Friday and whether you prefer to share via our SFTP or a Drive link? If helpful, I can send a short template for the control crosswalk.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Senior Security Analyst
NovaHealth

Thanks for the concise list and the template (received). We'll assemble a compact assurance docket that addresses each line item. Quick notes:

- Telemetry snapshot: we can produce an anonymized JSONL sample of inference telemetry plus a one-page latency/cost summary (p50/p90/p99, prefix cache hit rate).
- Config excerpt: we'll extract a sanitized snippet showing KV cache and retention fields for our Private deployment option.
- Audit report: we can share the latest SOC 2 Type II summary and a redacted control test matrix.

Jasmine and Kimberly — can you own producing the telemetry sample and the control crosswalk respectively? Goal: surface a deliverable package to Marta by EOD Fri 17 Jun.

Marta — SFTP is fine, and we can also post a Drive bundle (read-only). I'll confirm the link once artifacts are staged.
